build: Unified public customer site + company portal + immediate native Career claim

architecture.owner: JOB-09 owns the Tow public website, customer request flow, and company operations portal
architecture.browser_core_role: JOB-01 may host/link the site but does not own JOB-09 business logic
architecture.claim_behavior: A successful lien claim immediately creates one native Career/RLS inventory vehicle in the exact linked owned garage and retains a RedFox company asset record referencing the same inventory ID
architecture.failure_behavior: Before final commit, failures remove the temporary native vehicle, preserve custody, and take no acquisition charge; unresolved native conflicts are locked to prevent duplication
architecture.public_site: Tow My Current Vehicle and Dispatch Selected Service actions are wired to JOB-09 game actions
